title: Hino 300 4x4 Powder Coated Alloy Bullbar #11
description: Hino 300 4x4 powder coated hi-tensile Alloy Bullbar with heavy duty box uprights and extra heavy duty 10mm thick pressed hi-tensile aluminium main channel with a mounting for 17,000lb Sherpa winch. LED indicator lights are mounted in the outer box uprights. The main pipes are 76mm diameter heavy wall hi-tensile aluminium. Powder coating colours can be chosen from a wide range to suit your requirements.
